items.exampleEn: A small cat appeared at my door.
items.exampleZh: 一隻小貓出現在我家門口。

items.exampleEn: This restaurant serves breakfast all day.
items.exampleZh: 這家餐廳整天都供應早餐。

items.exampleEn: I'll send you an email tonight.
items.exampleZh: 我今晚會寄電子郵件給你。
我們預計大約會有五十位客人。

items.exampleEn: We reached the top of the mountain at noon.
Don't worry. Everything is under control.
items.exampleZh: 別擔心，一切都在掌控之中。

items.sentenceEn: The plane will reach Taipei at seven.

items.audioEn: Dinner will be served at seven in the garden.

items.sentenceEn: The sun appeared from behind the clouds.
items.sentenceZh: 太陽從雲後面露出來了。

items.sentenceEn: Please remain quiet in the library.
items.sentenceZh: 在圖書館裡請保持安靜。

items.stemEn: Be careful on the stairs. Don't ____.
items.stemZh: 下樓梯要小心，別跌倒了。

items.stemEn: I'll ____ you a message when I get home.
items.stemZh: 我到家的時候會傳訊息給你。

items.passageEn: Amy's restaurant opened last week. She expected many people on the first day, but at noon nobody came. She did not give up. She sent messages to all her friends. By six o'clock, the restaurant was full, and Amy served dinner to forty people. Everything was under control. When the last guest left, she almost fell asleep on a chair.
items.passageZh: Amy 的餐廳上週開幕。她原本預期第一天會有很多人來，但到了中午一個人都沒出現。她沒有放棄，傳訊息給所有朋友。到了六點，餐廳客滿了，Amy 為四十個人送上晚餐。一切都在掌控之中。最後一位客人離開時，她差點在椅子上睡著了。

questions.questionZh: 開幕第一天中午發生了什麼事？
Amy 怎麼解決這個問題？

items.promptZh: 我們預計下午三點到達。
referenceEn: We expect to arrive at three in the afternoon.
We expect to get there at three.
rubricZh: expect 後面可接 to＋原形動詞（例如 expect to arrive）；接 that 子句也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 send 造一個句子，說說你最近寄給或傳給別人的東西。
referenceEn: I sent my mother some photos yesterday.
Last week, I sent a birthday card to my friend.
rubricZh: 說過去的事用 send 的過去式（例如 sent）
送的東西和對象可寫在 sent 後面（例如 sent my mother some photos、sent a card to my friend）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：新規則：mcq 四選項同詞性（動詞），只能靠詞義判斷

執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：括號不成對：「可寫例如 sent my mother some photos、sent a card to my friend）」多一個右括號、缺左括號。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "送的東西和對象可寫在 sent 後面（例如 sent my mother some photos、sent a card to my friend）"（原 "可寫例如 sent my mother some photos、sent a card to my friend）"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似："at noon nobody appeared" 說客人沒來，英文較自然是 nobody came / nobody showed up；appear 用在「沒人出現」雖可懂但略生硬。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Amy's restaurant opened last week. She expected many people on the first day, but at noon nobody came. She did not give up. She sent messages to all her friends. By six o'clock, the restaurant was full, and Amy served dinner to forty people. Everything was under control. When the last guest left, she almost fell asleep on a chair."（原 "Amy's restaurant opened last week. She expected many people on the first day, but at noon nobody appeared. She did not give up. She sent messages to all her friends. By six o'clock, the restaurant was full, and Amy served dinner to forty people. Everything was under control. When the last guest left, she almost fell asleep on a chair."）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "expect 後面可接 to＋原形動詞（例如 expect to arrive）；接 that 子句也正確"（原 "expect 後面接 to＋原形動詞（例如 expect to arrive）"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：閱讀的 appeared 改掉後，補 appear 的情境句（control 另有單字卡與閱讀）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "The sun appeared from behind the clouds."（原 "The teacher has the class under control."）
